TIAMATBEAST-SEA_OF_LIFE_WOMB.title: Womb of the Sea of Life
TIAMATBEAST-SEA_OF_LIFE_WOMB.description: #At the start of each combat, enter Femme Fatale form, gain 10 NP Charge and spawn 1 Laḫmu. The first time each enemy becomes Cursed, spawn 1 Laḫmu.
TIAMATBEAST-SEA_OF_LIFE_WOMB.flavor: From the discarded womb of Genesis, life still pours — endless, unasked-for, and hers.
TIAMATBEAST-MOTHERS_TEARS.title: Mother's Tears
TIAMATBEAST-MOTHERS_TEARS.description: #Whenever you Devour Laḫmu, heal 2 HP for each Laḫmu devoured.
TIAMATBEAST-MOTHERS_TEARS.flavor: She weeps for every child she consumes — and that grief is what keeps her standing.
TIAMATBEAST-KING_HASSANS_HORN.title: King Hassan's Horn
TIAMATBEAST-KING_HASSANS_HORN.descriptio: #At the start of combat, gain Guts: the first time you would die, revive at 1 HP and spawn 3 Laḫmu.
TIAMATBEAST-KING_HASSANS_HORN.flavor: Only by granting her death can she be felled — so she answers death with more children.
TIAMATBEAST-HOLY_GRAIL_OF_THE_SEA_OF_LIF: Holy Grail of the Sea of Life
#Palingenesis: gain !MaxHp! Max HP. While held, limits break: Bond can reach level 12 and NP level can reach 6.
The mother of life cradles the vessel that promises life without limit.
